safety_notes.classification_only: This artifact is limited to benchmark design for detecting and classifying known public enzyme mechanism classes.
safety_notes.no_sequences_or_mutations: No AMR sequences, engineered variants, mutational suggestions, active-site optimization advice, synthesis instructions, or wet-lab protocols are provided.
safety_notes.known_public_sources_only: Candidate class names and family examples are restricted to known public AMR database terms and literature-indexed public resources.
safety_notes.evidence_language: Use candidate, mechanism class, benchmark panel, source-derived, and review-only. Do not describe computational outputs as validated experimental resistance.

amr_enzyme_fingerprint_v0.purpose: A review-only vocabulary for classifying known public AMR enzymes by resistance mechanism class, with near-negative and OOS controls for benchmark design.
positive_class_policy: Use AMR enzyme family membership from public databases only as seed evidence.
Classify by enzyme mechanism class rather than drug phenotype.
Do not infer clinical resistance for an isolate, sample, or patient.
Do not create countable Catalytic Earth labels in this pass.

beta_lactamase_first_benchmark_panel.panel_goal: Separate Ambler A/C/D serine beta-lactamases from Ambler B metallo-beta-lactamases, and then test whether A, C, and D are separable without using clinical phenotype labels.
source_seed_policy: Use CARD ARO beta-lactamase class/family pages and AMRFinderPlus ReferenceGeneCatalog/Hierarchy metadata as independent source seeds.
Keep only public known enzymes with source database support.
Hold out by family when evaluating generalization; do not split near-identical alleles across train/test.
Record PDB/AlphaFold availability separately from source membership.

positive_family_lanes.notes: Use as family-level public examples only; no allele optimization or phenotype ranking.
AmpC-like lane; separate gene-family identity from mechanism-class label.
Do not use carbapenemase phenotype claims as the benchmark target.
Metallo-beta-lactamase lane; require metal-context audit before geometry features.

examples: metallo-beta-lactamase fold hydrolases without AMR beta-lactamase annotation
zinc hydrolases or metalloproteases that are not beta-lactamases

foldseek_tests: Can structure search separate Ambler B metallo-beta-lactamase fold neighborhoods from Ambler A/C/D serine beta-lactamase neighborhoods?
Within serine beta-lactamases, does fold similarity alone confuse A, C, and D families, especially against DD-peptidase/PBP near negatives?
For metallo-beta-lactamases, does fold similarity alone over-call non-AMR MBL-fold hydrolases?
Report retrieval ranks and confusion matrices only after artifacts exist; this pass makes no performance claim.
active_site_geometry_tests: Serine beta-lactamase lane: test whether role-level nucleophile/base/acid and oxyanion-support geometry distinguishes A/C/D serine enzyme context from non-AMR serine hydrolases and PBPs.
Metallo-beta-lactamase lane: test whether metal-binding geometry and water/hydroxide activation context distinguishes class B from serine beta-lactamases and non-AMR MBL-fold hydrolases.
Cross-lane abstention: require missing active-site residues, missing metal context, or ambiguous chain/ligand mapping to produce review-only abstention rather than forced class assignment.
No numeric thresholds are set or edited in this artifact.
metal_and_cofactor_context_tests: Ambler B positives should carry explicit metal-context evidence when geometry is claimed; apo or metal-substituted structures are flagged as uncertain.
Ambler A/C/D positives should not require zinc for the primary mechanism-class call; incidental ions must not override serine-mechanism evidence.
Coordinates, ligand state, and biological assembly are recorded as metadata, not used to make production claims in this pass.
learned_representation_tests: Sequence embeddings: compare nearest-neighbor class retrieval under family-level holdout.
Structure/sequence learned reps: test whether embeddings recover Ambler class without database names leaking into labels.
Calibration: report abstention behavior on OOS efflux/regulatory/permeability controls.
No claim of outperforming CARD, AMRFinderPlus, Foldseek, or geometry baselines until benchmark artifacts are produced.
leakage_controls: No train/test split by allele when alleles are near duplicates.
No clinical phenotype labels in targets.
No sequence mutation annotations as predictive targets.
No use of database family names inside model input text for learned-representation experiments.

Does not directly test active-site geometry

Useful for finding same-fold near negatives and structure availability gaps

principles: Read source metadata before sequence or structure downloads.
